name: Amazing Grace
lrc:
[00:08.00] Amazing grace! How sweet the sound
[00:14.50] That saved a wretch like me!
[00:21.00] I once was lost, but now am found;
[00:27.00] Was blind, but now I see.
[00:34.00] 
[00:41.00] 'Twas grace that taught my heart to fear,
[00:47.50] And grace my fears relieved;
[00:54.00] How precious did that grace appear
[01:00.50] The hour I first believed.
[01:07.00] 
[01:14.00] Through many dangers, toils and snares,
[01:20.50] I have already come;
[01:27.00] 'Tis grace hath brought me safe thus far,
[01:33.50] And grace will lead me home.
[01:40.00] 
[01:47.00] The Lord has promised good to me,
[01:53.50] His word my hope secures;
[02:00.00] He will my shield and portion be,
[02:06.50] As long as life endures.
